lessonTitle: 41. The idea of a geometric solid
lessonTitleEnglish: The idea of a geometric solid
source: Based on the topics of the Armenian grade 11 mathematics textbooks (advanced stream)

stages.headline: A geometric solid is a bounded part of space enclosed by its surface (boundary): polyhedra, cylinders, cones, balls.
stages.headlineEnglish: A geometric solid is a bounded part of space enclosed by its surface (boundary): polyhedra, cylinders, cones, balls.

stages.headline: A point is interior if some small ball around it lies in the solid; every neighbourhood of a boundary point contains points inside and outside.
stages.headlineEnglish: A point is interior if some small ball around it lies in the solid; every neighbourhood of a boundary point contains points inside and outside.

stages.headline: A solid is convex if the segment joining any two of its points lies in it; cylinders, cones and balls are convex.
stages.headlineEnglish: A solid is convex if the segment joining any two of its points lies in it; cylinders, cones and balls are convex.
